items.title: Inbox avatar recovers from an unavailable image
items.precondition: A contained runtime is running with a conversation whose peer has an avatar URL that returns an image-load error.
steps: Locate the conversation with the unavailable peer avatar.
Inspect the avatar area and any unread or online indicator.
items.expected: The row shows the peer's existing initial avatar instead of a broken-image glyph, and any existing unread or presence indicator remains correctly placed.
items.notes: Confirmed by the user after local testing.

items.title: Valid avatar output is unchanged
items.precondition: A contained runtime is running with a user or peer whose avatar URL resolves to an image.
steps: Open the Messages inbox and a message thread or another shared-avatar surface.
Inspect the valid profile photo at each rendered size.
items.expected: The image remains visible, circular, cropped, and styled exactly as before; no initial fallback replaces a successfully loaded photo.
items.notes: Confirmed by the user after local testing.

items.title: A new avatar source can load after a prior error
items.precondition: A contained runtime can update an avatar URL from an unavailable resource to a valid uploaded resource without a full browser restart.
steps: Cause the profile avatar to show the initial fallback for an unavailable source.
Update the same profile to a valid avatar photo.
Refresh the relevant inbox or shared-avatar surface through the normal application flow.
items.expected: The new valid image displays. A prior failure does not permanently force the initial fallback for a different URL.
items.notes: Confirmed by the user after local testing.
